source.title: Derry Journal, 6 June 1961, p. 7 ("County of Londonderry: Notice of Result of Elections. Election of County Councillors, 1961")
source.publisher: Derry Journal (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed: the returning officer's official notice records no votes against Moneymore and declares Thomas James Fairley duly elected (Derry Journal, 6 June 1961)

note: Polled 1 June 1961: the Limavady Rural District notice of election (Derry Journal, 5 May 1961) fixes 'the day of Election' as Thursday 1 June 1961, and the county results were 'announced early this morning' in the Belfast News-Letter of 2 June 1961. Faughanvale and Dungiven were the only contested seats; the other seventeen members were returned unopposed, and sixteen of them are named in the Derry Journal's list of uncontested seats; the seventeenth, Moneymore, is supplied from the returning officer's official result notice of 6 June 1961. Not printed in the Derry Journal's list of uncontested seats on 19 May 1961; supplied from the official result notice. Returned unopposed.
